scope.currentDriven: Actual canonical g, length, damping, forcing amplitude/frequency/phase and the existing native RHS; phase-aware product-map parity is independently checked with createDrivenFlow.
scope.independentBenchmarks: fold-normal-form, pitchfork-normal-form, delayed-logistic, sine-circle and linear-oscillator are named independent models, never physical results attributed to the current pendulum.
scope.continuation: Phase-aware orchestration uses native findPeriodicOrbit. Phase-zero output is compared to the existing specialized continueDrivenPeriodicOrbit scanner.
scope.inputRunId: Immutable canonical input-experiment snapshot identity and parent chain; no persisted observation-run repository claim before S24.
scope.importedResults: Closed/versioned schema, source parameters, actual section and declared method are checked; external numerical rows/branches are not rerun or authenticated.

validation.profile: E + U (D/C, native numerical fixtures and isolated worker errors/cancel; desktop/mobile production journeys, keyboard/axe/reflow/visual regression)

build.evidenceBoundary: Retained build log includes Vite completion and public-artifact audit pass; execution-tool exit status is recorded by the operator separately.

caveats: Bounded selected fixtures establish numerical evidence only; they do not certify arbitrary physical parameters or all branches.
Melnikov is a weak-perturbation approximation. NS crossings, finite-time exponents, locking intervals and fold locations are numerical candidates, not existence proofs.
Torus full curves reload exactly; endpoint warm-start is not claimed because the existing solver has no saved-curve seed API.
Unwrapped-angle shooting excludes relative rotating cycles with nonzero winding number.
No human scientific review is implied.
